'''Cuvran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] explosives expert who lost his family during the occupation of his planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Cuvran assisted [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] during her [[Heurkea operation|mission]] to undermine the Empire on Dac.
